audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Shane’s Tunnelers invitation, Alex’s 5,000g secret-project request and accepted branch, and Emily’s Fiber request. Every spoken line, question and response, currency amount, relationship beat, meeting instruction, secret-project reference, item quantity, and canonical Fiber term was reviewed in full event context. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, money and special-order state, response branches, placeholders, gender and dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Farm records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
